Sime Darby Bhd's (KL:SIME) net profit jumped 36% to RM800 million in the first quarter ended Sept 30, 2024 (1QFY2025) from RM589 million a year ago, mainly on profit contributions from the UMW division and gain on disposal of Malaysia Vision Valley land. Gaming-to-plantation conglomerate Genting Bhd’s (KL:GENTING) net profit fell 57% year-on-year to RM223.8 million in 3QFY2024 from RM520.52 million as it was hit by higher property, plant and equipment write-off totalling RM207.3 million, as opposed to RM1.3 million last year. Quarterly revenue fell 11.2% to RM6.54 billion from RM7.37 billion due to declining contributions from its leisure and hospitality division. The latest quarterly revenue was its lowest since 1QFY2023, when it logged revenue of RM5.82 billion. — Genting's 3Q net profit more than halves on higher write-off.

Genting’s 49.3% subsidiary, Genting Malaysia Bhd's (KL:GENM), however, reported a net profit of RM569.16 million, representing a near six-year high and an over threefold jump from RM177.41 million. This was due to it recognising net unrealised forex gains of RM601.8 million on its US-dollar denominated borrowings, as opposed to a forex loss of RM1.7 million previously. Revenue was up a marginal 1.45% to RM2.75 billion from RM2.7 billion, on higher revenue from its leisure and hospitality businesses in the UK and Egypt. — Genting Malaysia's 3Q profit highest in nearly six years on forex gains.

PPB Group Bhd's (KL:PPB) net profit fell 44.1% to RM208.12 million in 3QFY2024 from RM372.55 million a year earlier, largely due to lower contribution from its 18.8%-owned associate Wilmar International Ltd, as well as lower profit from its core business segments. Quarterly revenue dropped 7.5% to RM1.35 billion from RM1.46 billion, mainly due to the absence of contribution from its Indonesian flour operations which was divested in September 2023. — PPB 3Q profit falls 44% on lower Wilmar contribution.

After four consecutive quarters of losses, Capital A Bhd (KL:CAPITALA) posted a record-high net profit of RM1.64 billion for 3QFY2024, as opposed to a net loss of RM102.75 million a year ago, as the group recognised RM2.27 billion in foreign exchange gains compared with a forex loss of RM93.92 million in last year’s corresponding quarter. The hefty forex gains were due to the weakening of the US dollar against local currencies of the markets where the group operates during the quarter. Its quarterly revenue grew by 16.6% to RM4.93 billion from RM4.23 billion. — Forex gains of RM2.27 bil lift Capital A earnings to record high in 3QFY2024.

Berjaya Corp Bhd (KL:BJCORP) posted a net loss of RM167.85 million for the three months ended Sept 30, 2024 (1QFY2025) against a net profit of RM111.08 million a year ago, dragged by its retail and services businesses. Quarterly revenue dropped 13.3% to RM2.23 billion from RM2.57 billion. — Berjaya Corp suffers another quarterly loss, optimistic some segments will improve.

Supermax Corp Bhd (KL:SUPERMX) extended its streak of losses to seven quarters with a net loss of RM64.6 million in the three months ended Sept 30, 2024 (1QFY2025), compared with RM2.05 million a year ago as a surge in operating expenses sank the glovemaker into the red, compounded by currency losses. Operating expenses were 77% higher, while the company also booked unrealised foreign exchange losses totalling RM45.6 million. Revenue, however, rose 26% to RM224.65 million from RM177.96 million as demand picked up.

title: As reported by The Edge, Genting (GENTING) and Genting Malaysia (GENM) are expected to be removed from the 30-stock FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBMKLCI) during the rebalancing on 20 Dec’24.
author: Trade With Maybank
body:
FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI’s Upcoming Rebalancing

As reported by The Edge, Genting (GENTING) and Genting Malaysia (GENM) are expected to be removed from the 30-stock FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI (FBMKLCI) during the rebalancing on 20 Dec’24.

GENTING is currently ranked 35th on Bursa, while GENM is at 38th by market capitalisation. Both counters have dropped over 20% YTD.

Potential replacements include Gamuda (GAMUDA) and 99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings (99SMART). GAMUDA shares have surged 98.7% YTD, supported by strong construction sector growth; while 99SMART, listed three months ago, rose by 52.1% from its IPO price of MYR1.65.

Bullish investors may consider GAMUDA-C2U and 99SMART-CU for leveraged exposure. Conversely, bearish investors may look out for GENTING-HI and GENM-HJ to hedge from any further declines in share price.

Meanwhile, Wall Street ended the week higher as sentiment improved after President Trump signed a memorandum outlining plans for reciprocal tariffs on countries taxing US products, instead of imposing immediate targeted tariffs. The US markets will be closed today in conjunction with Presidents’ Day public holiday. In the commodities market, Brent oil is hovering within the tight range around USD 74-75/barrel, given the prospects of Russian-Ukraine peace talks. Gold prices retraced toward USD2,882/ounce, while CPO prices rebounded and traded closer to the RM4,600 level.

Sector Focus: Market sentiment remains weak on the local front, driven by foreign institutional outflows and recent strong sell-offs across certain counters including CelcomDigi, Able Global, Notion and YBS International. Mr DIY Group (M) Bhd’s (KL:MRDIY) net profit declined 7.2% to RM147.2 million for 4QFY2024 from RM158.63 million a year earlier, due to higher costs related to the group's business expansion and growing store network. Quarterly revenue rose 2.6% to RM1.18 billion from RM1.15 billion in 4QFY2023, driven by a 13.8% increase in store count, which expanded to 1,435 outlets from 1,261. For FY2024, its net profit grew 1.5% to RM568.94 million from RM560.68 million in FY2023, as revenue climbed 6.7% to RM4.65 billion from RM4.36 billion. It declared an interim dividend of 1.8 sen per share, to be paid on March 28. This brings the total payout for FY2024 to five sen per share, making it the highest payout since the group's listing in October 2020. — Mr DIY pays highest dividend since listing for FY2024 despite drop in 4Q profit

Genting Bhd (KL:GENTING) posted its first quarterly loss in two years on higher finance costs and share of losses in joint ventures and associates. The net loss of RM169.39 million for 4QFY2024 compares with a net profit of RM150.99 million a year earlier. Quarterly revenue dropped 5.3% to RM6.88 billion from RM7.27 billion in 4QFY2023, mainly due to reduced contributions from the leisure and hospitality division. For FY2024, its net profit was RM882.95 million, a 4.96% decrease from RM929.20 million in FY2023, despite revenue rising 2.21% to RM27.72 billion from RM27.12 billion. It declared a final dividend of five sen per share, compared with nine sen a year earlier. This brings the total payout for FY2024 to 11 sen per share, lower than the 15 sen paid in FY2023. — Genting posts first quarterly loss in two years, declares lower dividend

Revenue grew 25.6% year-on-year (y-o-y) to RM18.11 million from RM14.42 million. Basic earnings per share stood at 1.57 sen, up from 1.31 sen a year earlier. — Ramssol’s 1Q net profit climbs 40% on strong demand for human capital management solutions

Farm Price intends to fix the exercise price of the warrants at 40 sen, which is a discount of 8.93% to the five-day volume weighted average market price of the company's share price of 43.92 sen as at April 30. It is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2025. — Farm Price plans one-for-two bonus issue of warrants

author: 财经头条
body:
MediaKUALA LUMPUR: Genting Malaysia Bhd is undertaking a RM2.2 billion restructuring of its wholly owned US subsidiary, Empire Resorts Inc to strengthen its capital structure and sharpen its long-term strategic focus in the northeastern US gaming market.In a filing with Bursa Malaysia today, Genting Malaysia said Empire Resorts will dispose of its non-gaming assets – including Resorts World Catskills Hotel, Alder Hotel, Monster Golf Course, RWC Epicenter and various restaurants – to the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation (SCRFLDC) for US$525 million (RM2.2 billion).Proceeds from the sale will be used to acquire 1,554.6 acres of land from EPR Properties for US$201.3 million (RM848.1 million), giving Empire Resorts full ownership of the land under both its gaming and non-gaming operations, along with additional development-ready land. The acquisition eliminates prior lease obligations, enabling Empire Resorts to better control its strategic assets.The disposal proceeds will also be used to fully redeem Empire Resorts’ outstanding US$300 million senior unsecured notes due November 2026. This early redemption will leave Empire Resorts debt-free and significantly improve its financial position by eliminating high-interest payments.Following the asset sale, Empire Resortswill lease back the non-gaming properties from SCRFLDC under a long-term land lease running through 2066, ensuring continued operational control. Additionally, Empire Resorts will manage these assets under a 20-year agreement with SCRFLDC, with automatic renewals of up to 10 more years.The restructuring is expected to improve Empire Resorts’ cost structure by removing lease payments to EPR and reducing interest expenses, while generating a surplus of about US$10 million (RM42.1 million) to support working capital.Genting Malaysia said this strategic realignment enhances Empire Resorts’ financial flexibility and asset base, reinforcing its competitiveness in the New York State gaming sector. The group added that Empire Resorts and SCRFLDC are currently finalising the detailed terms of the agreements.This marks a key milestone in Genting Malaysia’s ongoing efforts to streamline its international operations and maximise long-term shareholder value.

author: 双剑合璧KLSE吹水站 Channel
body:
GENM 云顶大马
以下是整理和归纳三篇针对 Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) 的分析报告的中文摘要，并突出它们之间的主要差异：

未来展望：计划出售Empire Resorts的非博彩资产，未来可减轻利息与租赁负担，并回收管理费用，但该资产买方拟发市政债的融资安排有所延迟。美国市场近期疲弱，消费情绪或抑制娱乐花费，运营环境依然挑战重重 。

---

Genting Malaysia (GENM MK) – Earnings beat expectations

机构：Phillip Capital（2025-08-29）

目标价：RM 2.10，投资评级：持有（HOLD），当前股价RM 2.04，上行潜力约+2.94% 。

业绩亮点：2025财年上半年（6M25）收入为RM 5.5 billion，同比增长1.5%，核心净利润RM 299 million，同比下降11%，但仍高于预期；第2季表现尤佳，季度收入环比上升13%至RM 2.9 billion，核心净利RM 244 million（环比+350%），EBITDA利润率上升2.3个百分点至28.8% 。

风险因素：下半年面临销售及服务税（SST）扩展、电费上调、新引入外国劳工公积金（EPF），可能压缩利润空间 。

预测与估值：上调2025–27年盈利预测10–73%，并把目标价从RM1.80调高至RM2.10（基于SOP法，市盈率由6倍提升至7倍），看好其于2026年“访马来西亚”活动的受益潜力，以及若获得纽约州下州赌场执照的催化作用 。

---

Genting Malaysia Berhad – Higher Gaming Profit & Forex Gains

机构：Public Bank（2025-08-29）

目标价：RM 1.84，投资评级：持有（HOLD），当前股价RM 2.04，下行潜力约‑9.80% 。

季度表现：第2季净利RM 416.7 million，较去年同期RM 82.2 million大幅上涨，主要因马来西亚和英国博彩收入提升以及确认外汇收益RM 184.6 million。剔除异常项目后，核心净利RM 186.5 million，同比增长128% 。

累计表现：2025上半年累计表现仍低于预期，仅达全年预估的40%，分析师维持盈利预测不变 。

未来展望：计划出售Empire Resorts的非博彩资产，未来可减轻利息与租赁负担，并回收管理费用，但该资产买方拟发市政债的融资安排有所延迟。美国市场近期疲弱，消费情绪或抑制娱乐花费，运营环境依然挑战重重 。

---

Genting Malaysia Berhad – Recovery in Sight

机构：TA Research（2025-08-29）

目标价：RM 2.24，投资评级：买入（BUY），当前股价RM 2.04，上行潜力约+9.80% 。

盈利表现：剔除外汇收益RM 253.5 million后，1H25核心净利RM 284.3 million，占全年预测的66%（分析师）与57%（市场共识）。调整后EBITDA同比增长24%至RM 1.8 billion（若剔除外汇收益则为RM 1.5 billion，同比下降1%） 。

季度环比：第2季核心净利环比翻五倍至RM 237.4 million，得益于季度收入环比增长12.5%、VIP与非VIP博彩收入分别增长8%与21%、以及更高的持有率 。

调整预测：维持2025–27年盈利预测，但下调股息预期由原先12/14/16仙/股降至8/10/12仙/股 。

管理层沟通：2H25预期仍有成本压力（SST扩展、电费、营销开支），预计全年EBITDA利润率约30%（1H25约33%）。Empire Resorts非博彩资产出售融资虽有延迟，但预计今年可完成。纽约下州赌场执照投标进程积极进行中，第二轮公众互动将于9月举行，赢家或于12月1日公布，年内会正式获奖 。

估值逻辑：采用DCF估值法，维持目标价RM 2.24，CAPM成本设为19.3% 。

---

综合结语（总结）

Phillip Capital 报告较为乐观，重点放在第2季强劲表现、访马2026红利与可能获得纽约执照，目标价调高至RM 2.10，并上修盈利预测，但仍建议持有。

Public Bank 的报告中立偏谨慎，强调外汇收益是利润大涨主因，累计上半年表现仍偏低，目标价较保守（RM 1.84），维持中性态度，也提醒成本挑战与收购市场风险。

TA Research 最为积极，认为集团已见复苏曙光，经营指标回暖、赌场业务稳定增长，且纽约执照进程顺利，维持买入评级并最高目标价RM 2.24，但也审慎调低未来股息，对于资本支出与成本上升持谨慎态度。

title: Genting Berhad 目前持有 Genting Malaysia Berhad 49.36% 股份。
author: TCYap马股投资频道 ✨ 😎
body:
📌《关于GENTING收购GENM》

1. Genting Berhad 目前持有 Genting Malaysia Berhad 49.36% 股份。
2.今天停牌，收市后宣布以每股 RM2.35 的价格收购 GENM 剩余的 50.64% 股权（约 28.7 亿股），总值约 RM6.74 billion。
3. 相较于 RM6.74 billion 的收购金额，GENTING 目前市值约 RM11.1 billion，并持有约 RM21 billion 的现金。
4. 此次收购主要与集团在美国的综合度假村及赌场牌照项目有关。
5. GENM 旗下的 Resorts World New York City 正竞标纽约赌场执照，这是位于纽约皇后区（Queens）价值约 USD5.5 billion（约 RM23.2 billion）的度假村发展项目的一部分。
6. 相信GENTING 需要更清晰的股权结构及更高的资金调配自主性，因此决定私有化 GENM。

【下市门槛】

1. 若公众持股仍高于 25%，GENM 可继续维持上市地位。
2. 当公众持股低于 25% 但高于10%，将不再符合上市条例，GENM 会被除牌下市。若股东在除牌前未出售股份，将成为私人公司的股东，无法在市场交易，但若公司派息，仍可获得股息。
4.当 GENTING 收购 GENM 超过 90% 股份，即触发强制性收购（compulsory acquisition），所有未卖出的股东都会被强制卖出股份，“塞钱入你袋”

*
🎰GENM于1989年在马股上市，并一度成为指数成分股，至今已有36年历史。你对此收购有何看法？GENTING的股价又会有何反应呢？

body:
What Happens to Structured Warrants Following Privatisation of Underlying Reference Asset

Following Genting’s (GENT) proposal to privatise Genting Malaysia (GENM) with an offer price of MYR2.35, many investors are wondering what will happen to GENM Structured Warrants; as stated in the Base Prospectus, all unexercised GENM Call Warrants will be automatically exercised and cancelled before their expiry date 🗓️.

For GENM Structured Warrants, this triggers an early termination event ⚠️.
The Cash Settlement Amount will depend on the moneyness of the Structured Warrants.

The Cash Settlement Amount will be calculated based on the lower of:
1. The privatisation offer price (MYR2.35 per share) 💵, or
2. The last traded market price of GENM shares before suspension 📊.

After settlement, the Call Warrants will cease trading and be removed from the market.

If the calculated amount zero or less, no payment will be made. Investors should note that GENM Structured Warrants may be suspended before delisting and settlement values may differ.

KLCI closed pretty flat around the 1611 points region but the overall market sentiment definitely had a huge rebound today. Daily trading volume also surged back towards the 4.2 billion mark, so far a good signal here.

Main stocks that showed strong buying momentum would be the likes of VELESTO, GENTING, DNEX, TFP, CMSB, ECOSHOP, MRDIY, SCIB. NOVAMSC, 99SMART, SEDANIA, K1, SUPERMX, CHEEDING, HARTA, and DAYANG All of which were able to sustain their rallies throughout the day on the top volumes list.

GENTING was definitely one of the star performers today, breaking out huge all the way towards the RM 3.40+ regions with huge volume and buying momentum after its offer to take GENM private at RM 2.35 per share.

For now looking quite strong here and as long as able to hold above its RM3.20+ immediate support, could continue to breakout further towards the RM 3.50+ major resistance levels in the coming week.

Will be monitoring GENTING closely.

DNEX on the other hand also had a huge breakout all the way towards the RM 0.29+ regions with huge volume and buying momentum out of nowhere. This came after consolidating over the past few months without much action.

This breakout out of nowhere definitely caught my attention and if able to hold above its RM 0.275+ immediate support, could be breaking out towards and beyond its RM 0.33+ major resistance levels soon.

Will be monitoring DNEX closely

CMSB had a huge breakout today, rallying all the way from its RM 1.42 major resistance levels towards the RM 1.51 regions with massive volume and buying momentum.

Although it wasn't able to close on its intraday high, its closing price of RM 1.48 was still a pretty bullish signal and if able to keep this kind of buying momentum, could be trending up further towards the RM 1.50 - RM 1.70+ major resistance levels soon.

Will be monitoring CMSB closely.

Genting Hits Seven-Month High on New York Casino Optimism
Genting (GENTING) rose over 5% to a seven-month high as optimism grew that its unit Genting Malaysia (GENM) could secure a New York gaming licence.

GENTING has jumped nearly 24% this week since announcing its MYR6.7 billion privatisation offer for GENM.

Analysts noted GENTING’s earnings could be diluted post-privatisation, but sentiment remains positive with 9 out of 15 analysts maintaining a BUY call.
